description: A vulnerability in BIG-IP APM occurs when a virtual server is configured with an APM access profile and a per-request policy, and the tmm.access.policytrace database key is enabled. This can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate unexpectedly, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The key is disabled by default, and there is no control plane exposure, only data plane impact.
